errors.name: UserNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a user is requested but not found in the system by user_id.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested but not found in the system by product_id.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested but not found in the system by order_id.

errors.name: InvalidUserRoleError
errors.description: Raised when a user attempts an action that is not permitted by their role, such as modifying a product or another user's data.

errors.name: MissingRequiredFieldError
errors.description: Raised when a required field (such as email or product name) is missing or empty during user or product creation.

errors.name: InvalidEmailError
errors.description: Raised when an email address is provided in an invalid format during user creation.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Raised when a product price is provided as a negative value or non-numeric during product creation.

errors.name: OrderCreationFailedError
errors.description: Raised when an order cannot be created due to a system-level constraint, such as a user not being authenticated or exceeding order limits.
